title: India Semiconductor Mission Approves 2 New Fab Projects in Gujarat (₹3,936 Crore)
summary: Cabinet approves Crystal Matrix Mini/Micro-LED fab at Dholera and Suchi Semicon OSAT facility at Surat, taking total ISM projects to 12.

blocks.content: Union Cabinet approved 2 semiconductor units under ISM: **Crystal Matrix Ltd** (₹3,936 Cr GaN Mini/Micro-LED display fab in Dholera) and **Suchi Semicon** (OSAT plant in Surat), taking total ISM investment to ₹1.64 lakh crore across 12 projects.
